response.sql:
WITH account_avg AS (
  SELECT account_id, AVG(amount) as avg_amount
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(amount) as overall_average
  FROM trans
)
SELECT 
  a.account_id,
  a.avg_amount,
  a.avg_amount - o.overall_average as excess
FROM account_avg a
CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
WHERE a.avg_amount > o.overall_average
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Calculate average magnitude of transaction amounts as stored (unsigned values), without considering transaction direction (trans.type). The request asks for 'average transaction amount'—which in financial contexts refers to transaction size/magnitude—rather than 'net effect' or 'transaction balance change'.

alternatives.interpretation: Consider the net direction of each transaction: credits (PRIJEM) as positive, withdrawals (VYDAJ, VYBER, etc.) as negative. This gives the average *effect* of transactions rather than average magnitude.
alternatives.sql:
WITH account_avg AS (
  SELECT account_id, AVG(amount * CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) as avg_amount
  FROM trans
  GROUP BY account_id
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(amount * CASE WHEN type = 'PRIJEM' THEN 1 ELSE -1 END) as overall_average
  FROM trans
)
SELECT 
  a.account_id,
  a.avg_amount,
  a.avg_amount - o.overall_average as excess
FROM account_avg a
CROSS JOIN overall_avg o
WHERE a.avg_amount > o.overall_average
ORDER BY excess DESC
LIMIT 10;
